title: Execution plan (immutable creation-time snapshot)
description: The plan as computed once, at creation. ITS IMMUTABILITY IS THE POINT: 'the worker's risk math reads THIS, never a re-derived plan' (executor.execution_plans doc). A rescale does not edit this row - it appends a separate plan JSON in the plan table and a PLAN_RESIZED event, so history shows what was intended and what replaced it. Persisted as jsonb under execution_id (one row per execution, PRIMARY KEY execution_id).

stop.description: Null when the intent has no protective stop - absence is not a zero price.

take_profit.description: Often empty; each level carries a price and the FRACTION of the position it closes.

strategy_config.description: Strategy parameters (interval, jitter, slice count, ...). Free-form because each strategy owns its own keys; the strategy field says how to read them.

quantity.description: Planned total, already rounded DOWN onto the instrument grid.

market_type.description: USDT-linear perpetual only in the MVP.

side.description: Order side. A spot sell-open is refused outside explicit margin support.

intent.description: What the user wants the order to do to the position - not what the venue will do.

execution_status.description: Execution lifecycle. FROZEN: this list is cross-checked against apps/web/src/platform/executor/types.ts and contracts/openapi/fudcourt.yaml by contracts/scripts/check-contract.mjs (CHECKED_ENUMS), so it MUST NOT be re-spelled or reordered, and it MUST NOT be merged with ChildOrderStatus.

child_order_status.description: Child-order lifecycle. FROZEN and cross-checked like execution_status. UNKNOWN is a real state, not an error: a non-terminal child with no venue row and no SUBMITTING grace is marked UNKNOWN + EXTERNAL_STATE_CHANGE so fill ingestion decides the truth.

execution_mode.description: LIVE is fail-closed behind the FUDCOURT_EXECUTOR_LIVE kill switch; a paper execution reuses the account's market/fee/balance context but NEVER sends an order.

stop_mode.description: How a protective stop is managed; native preferred.

balance_basis.description: A percentage sizing mode MUST name the balance basis explicitly - a percent of an unnamed basis is not a size.

sizing_mode.description: The nine sizing modes of SizingDefinition['mode']. Percent-valued modes require balance_basis to be present (the sizing engine refuses a percent mode without a basis).

child_order_type.description: The two order types the engine emits. The SQL column is unconstrained text; this enum is the value set the code writes.

error_category.description: Retry taxonomy: only network_retryable / rate_limited / exchange_overload may retry. Mirrors contracts/schemas/error-envelope.json's coarser 12-value `code` set - the envelope is the wire contract, this is the executor's internal classification.

event_name.description: A STABLE event id from contracts/events/catalog.json (PascalCase), whose SCREAMING_SNAKE spellings are accepted aliases of the same id. NOT re-enumerated on purpose: events/catalog.json + events/event.schema.json are the single source of truth and are pinned by contracts/scripts/check-contract.mjs; a second list here would be a drift surface. Note the live asymmetry: the executor enum (apps/executor/internal/executor/enums.go) declares 23 of the catalogue's 28 ids - the five account/credential/reconciliation events (CredentialCreated, CredentialRevoked, ExchangeAccountConnected, ReconciliationStarted, ReconciliationCompleted) exist in the catalogue and in the web implementation but have no Go constant yet.

execution_strategy.description: The eight strategies that exist in this build (executor/enums.go). The objective's sketch also names VWAP and smart-limit; they have no implementation and no oracle, so they are deliberately absent.

entry_definition.description: Exactly one arm. A market entry has NO price field at all - not a null price, an absent key - which is how the engine distinguishes 'market' from 'limit at 0'.

fraction.description: Fraction of the position to close at this level (0..1). Absent means full close.

take_profit_definition.description: One take-profit level. fraction is the 0-1 ratio type: writing 42 here would close the position 42 times, which is why the scale lives in the type name.

leverage_definition.description: Manual names a number; auto_safe deliberately has NO leverage field because the engine derives it from the venue's own brackets.
